# SPARQL.Client v0.5.1 - Table of Contents

A SPARQL client for Elixir.

## Pages

- [Change Log](https://sparql-client.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [SPARQL.Client](https://sparql-client.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Client.md): A SPARQL protocol client.
- [SPARQL.Client.Request](https://sparql-client.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Client.Request.md): A struct representing a HTTP request of a SPARQL protocol operation.

- Exceptions
  - [SPARQL.Client.HTTPError](https://sparql-client.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Client.HTTPError.md): Exception returned when a HTTP request of a SPARQL protocol operation fails with a non-2XX status.
